sermon.title: Mother’s Day — May 8, 2022
sermon.speaker: Various (Mother’s Day service)
sermon.summary: Church mothers share tips: protect the family, model Christ’s love, remember your Creator and seek the fruit of the Spirit. Mothers of the Bible—the Hebrew midwives, Lemuel’s mother and the woman who loved much—show fear of God and humble love.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sharing begins at 21:48 after worship.
